crossRefs.note: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

translations.bsb: To those who by perseverance in doing good seek glory, honor, and immortality, He will give eternal life.
